name: youtube-revenue-dashboard
description: Multi-channel YouTube revenue & analytics dashboard with real-time revenue estimation

scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,client -c blue,magenta "node --watch server/index.js" "npm --prefix client run dev"
scripts.build: npm --prefix client install --no-audit --no-fund && npm --prefix client run build
scripts.test: node scripts/test-estimator.js && node scripts/test-livecounts.js && node scripts/test-trending.js
